name: asset-transport-diagnostic
command: import {serveHosted} from "@runeditrun/rer/internal/cli/hosted-output.mjs"; const h=await serveHosted(process.cwd(),{declaration:"deploy.json"}); try { for (const headers of [{},{host:"rer-hosted-check.invalid"},{host:"rer-hosted-check.invalid",accept:"text/css,*/*;q=0.1","accept-encoding":"gzip, deflate, br, zstd","sec-fetch-mode":"no-cors","sec-fetch-dest":"style",referer:"https://rer-hosted-check.invalid/"}]) { try {const r=await h.fetch("rer-theme.css",{headers}); console.log(JSON.stringify({headerNames:Object.keys(headers),status:r.status,bytes:(await r.arrayBuffer()).byteLength}));} catch(e){console.error(e.message,e.cause?.code,e.cause?.message); process.exitCode=1;} } } finally {await h.close();}
